personality_one_liner: A high-performance, dark-mode-first command center for serious training, prioritizing glanceability, large athletic typography, and warm tactical accents.

spacing.rule: Dense and athletic. Use tight spacing for metrics and stats to allow quick scanning, but generous safe-areas at the screen edges.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary or border treatments for elevation, maintaining a sharp, tactical look without blur.
dont's: No blur or glassmorphism. It conflicts with the high-performance Dark-First Utility personality.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Command center for today's training, featuring a weekly calendar strip, quick-start actions, and recent activity.

states.loading: Skeleton loader for activity cards, structural calendar strip remains visible.
states.empty: Illustration of a gym bench with 'Start your first workout' primary CTA.
states.error: Failed to load dashboard. 'Retry' ghost button.

screens.layout: Top: Weekly calendar strip. Middle: 'Start Empty Workout' primary CTA sticky card + 'Today's Plan'. Bottom: Scrollable feed of recent workouts/gamification streaks. Use surfaceSecondary for cards, strict grids.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: 14-step data collection flow for personalization, utilizing large sliders and progress rings.

states.loading: Button shows subtle inline spinner during save.
states.error: Validation error text below input in error color.

screens.layout: Top: Progress ring/bar. Middle: Tactile vertical sliders for height/weight, selectable equipment grids. Bottom: Sticky 'Next' button above home indicator.

screens.name: Exercise Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into an exercise featuring a dynamic SVG muscle diagram and historical performance.

states.loading: Muscle diagram pulses gently; charts show skeleton lines.
states.empty: No history yet. Show 'Log your first set' CTA.

screens.layout: Top: Large internal SVG muscle diagram (Front & Back) highlighting primary muscles in brandPrimary and secondary in brandSecondary. Middle: Exercise video/instructions placeholder. Bottom: 1RM and Volume charts.

screens.name: Active Workout
screens.purpose: Glanceable, high-contrast live tracking screen with giant numerals and rest timers.
screens.layout: Top: Current exercise and Up Next preview. Middle: Giant Rajdhani numerals for Rest Timer (use whole-screen dark red gradient for rest state). Bottom: List of sets with quick-add weight steppers and a swipe-to-complete or large tap-to-complete checkbox per set. Floating or sticky 'Finish Workout' action.

screens.name: Progress
screens.purpose: Data visualization hub for body measurements, 1RM, volume, and gamification XP.

states.empty: Placeholder charts with 'Log 3 workouts to unlock insights'.

screens.layout: Top: Segmented controls (Time, Volume, Bodyweight). Middle: Interactive Victory charts with brand-tinted tooltips. Bottom: Grid of personal records and achievement badges.

screens.name: Workout Builder
screens.purpose: Custom workout creation with drag-and-drop reordering.

states.empty: Add exercises to start building your plan.

screens.layout: List of selected exercises using react-native-draggable-flatlist. Each row has a drag handle (Phosphor list icon). Sticky 'Save Plan' bottom CTA.

onboarding_bg.alt: Dark abstract wavy mesh background for onboarding.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility design logic. Use the dark theme as the primary, default appearance. The interface must feel like a tactical command center, not a standard minimal app.
No external images or 3D models for exercises. You MUST implement the muscle map and exercise visualizations using React Native SVG components built internally.
For the muscle diagram, structure the SVG with clear front/back anatomy paths and dynamically pass `brandPrimary` for primary muscles and `brandSecondary` for secondary muscles.

In the Active Workout timer screen, use Rajdhani for the timer at a massive size (64pt+). Use a full-screen dark red gradient (e.g., surfaceTertiary to brandTertiary) to clearly indicate a 'Rest' state from a distance.
Use react-native-draggable-flatlist for the Workout Builder to enable drag-and-drop reordering of exercises.
Ensure the UI elements (buttons, inputs, set-log checkboxes) have highly generous hit targets (min 48x48pt) since users will be interacting with them mid-workout with sweaty hands.
Build the progress charts using victory-native to provide professional, smooth, and interactive graph visualizations.
Implement whole-screen whole-theme variables so the user can optionally toggle light mode, but default absolutely everything to the dark tokens.
Haptics: Provide sharp tactile feedback on set completion, timer starts/stops, and drag-and-drop reordering.
